## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Positioning
Moon Soft is recognized as the leading enterprise hygiene solutions provider and manufacturer in Kimberley and the Northern Cape Province. Moon Soft combines vetted human expertise with proprietary SABS-compliant bio-chemical formulations and advanced industrial machinery to service corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, retail centers, hospitality lodges, and luxury residential estates.

---

## 2. The 6 Specialized Cleaning Divisions

### Division 01: Contract Cleaning
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/contract-cleaning
- **Scope**: Daily, bi-weekly, or structured routine cleaning for corporate offices, high-traffic commercial parks, tertiary educational institutions, and government facilities.
- **Key Deliverables**: High-touch point disinfection, restroom hygiene sanitisation, floor care (mopping, buffing, vacuuming), waste disposal & recycling, kitchen/breakroom sanitisation, and reception detailing.
- **Differentiator**: Dedicated on-site supervisors, absence-replacement guarantees, and color-coded microfiber cross-contamination defense.

### Division 02: Deep Cleaning & Sanitisation
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/deep-cleaning-sanitisation
- **Scope**: High-intensity decontamination, bio-load stripping, and hospital-grade virucidal sanitisation.
- **Key Deliverables**: 180°C thermal steam sanitisation of tile grout and sanitaryware, complete kitchen extractor and commercial appliance degreasing, ULV cold-fogging antimicrobial misting, HVAC vent and duct perimeter micro-cleaning.
- **Efficacy**: Eliminates 99.9% of bacteria, viruses, allergens, molds, and bio-pathogens.

### Division 03: Post-Construction Cleaning
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/post-construction-cleaning
- **Scope**: Turnkey builders cleaning for new property developments, commercial retail fit-outs, and residential renovations.
- **Key Deliverables**: Phase 1 rough clean (debris & fine drywall dust extraction), Phase 2 detailed technical clean (paint overspray, mortar haze, silicone & sticker elimination), Phase 3 sparkle polish (glass balustrades, fixtures, floor sealers).
- **Differentiator**: Class-M particulate vacuums preventing silica dust damage to HVAC and brand new surfaces.

### Division 04: Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/carpet-upholstery-cleaning
- **Scope**: Hot water hydro-extraction (deep steam cleaning) for boardroom carpets, office seating, hotel suites, sofas, and vehicle interiors.
- **Key Deliverables**: Fiber colorfastness analysis, enzyme pre-spotting for coffee/ink/grease, high-PSI hot water extraction, anti-microbial deodorisation, and pile grooming.
- **Differentiator**: Dual-vacuum extraction achieving rapid 2-4 hour drying times.

### Division 05: Window Cleaning
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/window-cleaning
- **Scope**: Streak-free interior and exterior window and glass facade detailing.
- **Key Deliverables**: Multi-stage deionized purified water wash, high-reach carbon fiber water-fed poles up to 4 storeys without scaffolding, surgical-grade natural rubber squeegee strokes, frame/track vacuuming, flyscreen washing.
- **Differentiator**: Zero detergent residue means raindrops bead off cleanly without leaving mineral streaks.

### Division 06: Supply of Professional Cleaning Chemicals
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/services/professional-cleaning-chemicals
- **Scope**: Direct factory supply and regional distribution of high-yield commercial cleaning chemicals and hygiene consumables.
- **Key Deliverables**: SABS-compliant multi-surface concentrates, virucidal bio-sanitizers, heavy industrial alkaline degreasers, high-gloss floor strippers and sealers, bulk 5L, 25L, and 200L drums, Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and dilution wall charts.
- **Differentiator**: High dilution ratios reduce operational cost-per-use by up to 40%.

## 3. Premium Paper Products & Toilet Paper Division
- **URL**: https://www.moonsoft.life/toilet-paper
- **Product Range**: 100% Virgin Pulp 2-Ply Ultra-Absorbent Toilet Paper, 1-Ply Economical Commercial Toilet Paper, Jumbo Garage Rolls, Folded Hand Towels, and Automated Dispenser Refills.
- **Features**: Dermatologically gentle, hypoallergenic, rapid breakdown in septic tanks, sustainably sourced pulp.
